title: Proton Radius Triangulation: Source-Calibrated Small-Radius Support with Scattering Source-Ceiling Caveats
description: Public archive packet for Proton Radius Triangulation. The June 23 prove-gate-confirmed packet reports source-backed small-radius support with explicit caveats: Triangulation A is the lead confirmed no-fit support leg, Triangulation B is retained as conditional ordinary-H support with convention-explicit significance, and RF-ENV-01 is retained only as an artifact-validated conditional diagnostic rather than a terminal proof. The archive excludes local copies of third-party PDFs and ancillary source files; those sources are cited in a source ledger and remain under their original terms.
